programs.title: Animal Fight Club
programs.desc:
There is a constant struggle in the animal kingdom.Lions, elephants, polar bears and cobras engage in deadly fights.The cameras capture scenes full of tension, drama and determination.Each fight has a story behind it.An alligator boldly wanting to assert its dominance, a hungry bear fighting for food, or a fox taking part in a mating ritual - they will show their capabilities.Unique recordings show the colorful and cruel world of animals.Tactics, hidden weapons, deception - wild creatures use all possibilities and will stop at nothing to survive
Another clash of the most dangerous animals from different continents.Among the most feared predators found in Australian waters are sharks and saltwater crocodiles.We will see what will happen when representatives of these dangerous species fight fiercely for the carcass of a large turtle.In turn, in Africa, two black rhinos - among the heaviest land mammals in the world - are fighting a bloody battle for territory.Another heroine of the episode is a praying mantis, which in its madness destroys everything it encounters on its way.
